messages:
marco: Quick thread to lock the GA handoff + contingency plan. We need one-liners for the acceptance check per area (SLA text, public docs, oncall, dashboards/alerts, billing readiness, customer comms). Also want a simple safety-net plan if things go sideways during cutover.

lina: I'll own the public SLA page + customer email. Green: SLA page published and legal-approved copy. Also draft a short customer comms template for the cutover (what to expect, rollback notice). ETA tomorrow noon.

ash: Engineering runtime owner here. Green: deployment playbook in repo + 3% canary for 1h with automated rollback on >=P1. Performance gating: p95 dedicated <= 150ms, hosted p95 <= 250ms. I'll add a traffic shadow run for 24h before cut.

dev: Observability: I'll own dashboards and alerts. Green: Real-time GA dashboard (latency buckets, error rate by route, KV cache hit %) and P1/P2 alerts wired to PD. Example alert snippets:
```
# high error-rate
sum(rate(redwood_errors_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[5m])) by (route) > 0.02
# p99 latency spike vs baseline
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > baseline_p99 * 2
```
I'll pin runbook links to the dashboards.

yuki: Support/SDR: I'll own the post-GA support rota and customer escalation matrix. Green: PagerDuty schedule and a `#ga-launch-support` channel exist, and support playbook uploaded. Recommend an 8am-8pm rota for first 7 days, escalate to 24/7 if >3 customers onboards.

priya: Billing/FinOps: I'll own billing events + invoice-preview. Green: billing events emitted for all GA routes; invoice preview shows sample month and discounts. Need event schema sample and a mapping table for SKUs.

marco: Contingency plan ideas: short-circuit traffic to pilot-only lane, rollback model binary, or flip routing to last-stable variant. Which do we prefer as primary?

ash: Primary: flip routing to last-stable variant (fastest), secondary: revert infra change and scale down traffic. We should have a hotfix branch ready for model/config toggles.

dev: Also propose a "soft-stop" gate: if any P1 fires during canary, pause traffic increase and run postmortem checklist. Add a manual approval step in the cutover runbook.

lina: Communications: if we rollback, we should auto-send an email to affected customers explaining the incident and ETA. I'll draft a short template: "We encountered degraded performance and reverted to a safe version to protect your requests. We expect restoration within X hours. Contact support at ..."

yuki: Ops note: Recommend we tag GA customers with metadata (ga_launch=true) so paging/alerts can filter on impacted accounts. Also add an opt-in for elevated SLA during ramp.

priya: I'll accept the tag approach. I'll also add a billing attribute so we can exclude pilot discounts if customers cross a threshold.

marco: Final asks: each owner paste their single-line green gate onto the launch board and attach artifacts (links to runbooks, SLA page, dashboard, schema). I'll run a pre-cut handoff Wed 09:00 PT and a final go/no-go Fri 11:00 PT. If no objections, we'll follow this plan. :white_check_mark:
